name: TwigBaseCoralFactory
caption: A white base mesh 3D model of a twig coral structure. The object shows the raw geometric skeleton of a twig coral — a dense central point from which many slender, smooth branches extend outward and upward in all directions, with each branch further splitting into finer sub-branches toward the tips. Without any texture or material color, the pure white geometry clearly exposes the intricate, low-growing branching network with an extremely complex cast shadow on the white background below.
